sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 90

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 90:1
items.html: This world too divides into BYA and the place of the Klipot, because the place of the Temple is the Beriah of this world, the Land of Israel is the Yetzirah of this world, outside the Land is the Assiyah of this world, and the deserts and the places of ruins are the place of the Klipot of this world. (Item 44).
